title: Empirical Spectral Analysis of Alignment: Do Aligned Models Have Different Eigenvalue Spectra?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: If alignment has a consistent spectral signature, this could enable detection of alignment without behavioral testing. However, the causal chain from spectral properties to actionable safety improvements is indirect and exploratory.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: SVD computation and NTK approximation are standard numerical linear algebra operations. Comparing base vs. aligned models requires loading two model versions.
